name: wire-cut-control
description: MERN dashboard for an ESP32-based automated wire cutting system.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:memory: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:mem --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
